setup.why: need a real dataset uuid to invoke list_dataset_linked_test_cases

contract.notes: Declared 200 envelope is exactly {test_cases:[...], info:{page,page_size,count,prev,next}} with NO `success` key, per describeCapability guidance ('This response has NO success key, unlike every other dataset endpoint'). Actual response matched exactly: keys were test_cases and info only, info had all five required sub-fields (page:1, page_size:30, count:0, prev:null, next:null), and no success key was present. No structural drift observed at the envelope level.

notes: EMPTY-CASE: the only dataset in project 379335744 (found via list_datasets) is '__probe-dataset-1789734836192' (uuid 92d4a614-57d3-4201-8ffc-3f3c9faf9747), and list_datasets already reported test_cases_count:0 for it before this call was made. This is case 2 of the empty-case rule: a dataset EXISTS (confirmed reachable) and the capability call succeeded (200) with the declared envelope shape intact, but it returned an empty test_cases array (count:0) because no test cases are linked to it. The capability itself is reachable and its container contract (test_cases/info, no success key, info sub-fields) is verified and matches the declared schema exactly. What could NOT be verified is the per-item shape of a linked test-case row (declared only as a bare `{type:object}` with no fields specified, and describeCapability's own guidance notes the row shape is 'passed through from the backing store unchanged; not shaped by this service'), because no dataset in this project/pool had a linked test case. No dataset was created and no case was linked, per instructions. Verdict is UNVERIFIED specifically for item_shape, not because the capability is broken or unreachable -- distinct from the other empty-case scenario (no dataset existing at all), which did not occur here.
